'''Chris Harmon''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Raleigh tournament]] on 12 August 2000 with Space With Little Ground, according to Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-18-raleigh-nc-8-12-00d1144/ raleigh-nc-8-12-00], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 18 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-18-raleigh-nc-8-12-00d1144/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
